description: This file contains R functions for managing SparkSession catalogs, including listing catalogs, creating and dropping tables and views, and managing cache and partitions within a Spark environment.

methods.name: currentCatalog
methods.description: Returns the current default catalog name.

methods.name: listCatalogs
methods.description: Returns a list of available catalogs as a DataFrame.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates a table based on a data source.

methods.name: uncacheTable
methods.description: Removes a table from in-memory cache.

methods.name: tables
methods.description: Returns a DataFrame of table names in a database.

methods.name: tableNames
methods.description: Returns a list of table names in a database.

methods.name: getDatabase
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific database.

methods.name: listTables
methods.description: Returns a DataFrame of tables/views in a database.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific table.

methods.name: refreshTable
methods.description: Refreshes cache and metadata of a table.

methods.name: refreshByPath
methods.description: Refreshes cache for data source path.
